title: Energy return in running shoes explained (2025)
summary: This is a consumer guide from RunRepeat explaining what energy return means in running shoes, how it's scientifically measured, and why it matters for running performance. The article covers the biomechanics of energy return, testing methodologies, and practical implications for runners choosing footwear.
problem_solved: Helps runners understand what 'energy return' means in running shoes and how to evaluate it when purchasing footwear.
why_valuable: Provides scientific context for an often-marketed feature, helping consumers make informed decisions rather than relying on brand claims.
